description: This file implements an audio filter 'KrispFilter' utilizing Krisp's noise reduction technology. It manages a singleton KrispAudioProcessor instance, provides functions to initialize, start, stop, and process audio frames for noise cancellation, and handles external dependencies including an external Krisp processor module.

classes.name: KrispProcessorManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing the shared KrispAudioProcessor instance for efficient resource use.

classes.name: KrispFilter
classes.description: An audio filter class implementing Krisp noise suppression, compatible with real-time audio streams, marked deprecated in favor of KrispVivaFilter.

methods.name: KrispProcessorManager.get_processor
methods.description: Fetches the singleton KrispAudioProcessor instance, creating it if it does not exist, with specified audio parameters.

methods.description: Initializes the KrispFilter with specified sample type, channel count, and model path, issuing a deprecation warning.

methods.name: KrispFilter.start
methods.description: Initializes processing with the given sample rate.

methods.name: KrispFilter.process_frame
methods.description: Handles control frames to enable or disable filtering.

methods.name: KrispFilter.filter
methods.description: Performs noise reduction on provided audio bytes using Krisp's processor.
